:::{#exr-expected-density}

#### Expected value of a density

Let $X$ be a [continuous random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-continuous-rv) with density $\p(X=x)$.
The density evaluated at the random value $X$ is itself a random variable, $\p(X=X)$.

1. Use @thm-lotus to write $\E{\p(X=X)}$ as an integral.
2. Evaluate it when $X \sim \text{Uniform}(a, b)$ ([uniform distribution](random-variables.qmd#def-uniform)).
3. Evaluate it when $X \sim \ndist{\mean, \ss}$ ([normal distribution](random-variables.qmd#def-normal)).

Use the integral $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-u^2}\,du = \sqrt{\pi}$.

:::
